records.text: An Amani'shi warrior who hurls axes and strikes with Raptor Strike.
Akil'zon, the Eagle Avatar, calls himself the predator and intruders his prey. He promises strangers a quick death, urges his fellows to feed, and snarls with impatience and contempt at opponents.

Nalorakk, the Bear Avatar, commands guards and riders to attack, pressuring the guards with the threat that they should fear him more than their enemies. He declares that the Amani will rule again, revealing his cause as well as his place in the fighting.
Halazzi, the Lynx Avatar, demands that intruders bow to fang and claw and promises to carve them up. He says he fights with an untamed spirit.

Jan'alai, the Dragonhawk Avatar, calls on dragonhawk spirits and directs hatchers to work on the eggs. He threatens strangers and friends alike, saying that the hatchlings will be fed by their bodies; he also links their deaths to his own power.
An Amani'shi warbringer who fights mounted on a bear and dismounts when badly hurt.
An Amani'shi medicine man supports the fight with healing magic, casting a Healing Ward once combat begins. The title marks a healer within the Amani'shi ranks.
An Amani'shi tribesman is a combatant who uses Cyclone Strike against an opponent. The title places this fighter among the Amani'shi, without indicating a more individual identity.
An Amani bear is a hostile animal combatant that can become enraged in a fight.
An Amani'shi scout serves as an alert lookout, warning, “Invaders! Sound the alarm!” The line presents the scout as responding to an intrusion and calling others to raise the alarm.
An Amani'shi flame caster who hastens itself and hurls volleys of fireballs.
An Amani'shi guardian defending Zul'Aman, an armed sentry who cries out about intruders and sounds the alarm; it also roars to startle foes.
An Amani'shi trainer who can incite rage and put foes to sleep.
A dragonhawk egg in Zul'Aman that hatches into a dragonhawk hatchling when struck by the Hatch Eggs spell.
An Amani dragonhawk that breathes flame.
Zul'jin proclaims the return and vengeance of the Amani empire, threatening anyone who stands in their way. He boasts of new tricks, invoking bear, eagle, fang and claw, and dragonhawk.
An Amani'shi savage, a humanoid fighter who hamstrings, rends and sunders armor.

Zungam is a troll held captive in Zul'Aman, where he was seized while carrying a Tattered Voodoo Doll. His cousin Prigmon sent help after spotting his signal flare. Once free, Zungam gives the rescuer his remaining coin and offers his services; he asks that the doll be taken to his friend Griftah for appraisal.
An Amani lynx that uses stealth while out of combat.
An Amani crocolisk that lashes out with its tail.
An Amani'shi beast tamer who calls beasts to fight and domesticates them.
A young Amani lynx that lurks in stealth until a fight begins.
An Amani'shi handler who uses tranquilizing poison in combat.
A tamed crocolisk found among the Amani forces in Zul'Aman. It is a trained beast, but its infected bite makes it dangerous to approach in a fight.
An Amani'shi lookout in Zul'Aman, watching for approaching enemies. The lookout calls to Akil'zon when invaders approach, showing that the warning is meant for the Amani'shi's leader.
An Amani'shi wind walker, a spellcaster among the Amani forces who strikes with Frost Shock.
An Amani'shi protector among the Amani forces in Zul'Aman. It fights at close range with Mortal Strike, so its protective role comes with a serious threat to intruders.

Hex Lord Malacrass is a powerful Amani troll who faces intruders in Zul'Aman. He taunts opponents with threats of darkness and suffering, drains their power, and boasts that their souls will bleed. At his death, he insists that this is not the end for him.

Harrison Jones warns a stranger that Zul'Aman is dangerous for lighthearted adventurers. In a gong-event line, he says coordinated strikes could break the doors' seal and that at least five helpers are needed to enter.
Malacrass bears the title of Hex Lord.
An Amani'shi berserker in Zul'Aman who strikes with mighty blows and falls into a frenzy when badly wounded.
An Amani elder lynx that becomes enraged and frenzied when badly hurt.
Amani'shi Tempest is a humanoid combatant that casts Thunderclap in battle.

place_records.text: You are in Zul'Aman, a place of the Amani trolls, in the Ghostlands. Amani trolls hold it under Zul'jin, who proclaims the return of the Amani empire, with the Bear Avatar Nalorakk and Hex Lord Malacrass among its lords. Amani'shi guardians stand within. A troll captive named Zungam is held there. Recruits sent by Budd Nedreck of Hatchet Hills went in after Nalorakk and have gone missing.
